boards.school_name: Nebraska Methodist College of Nursing & Allied Health
boards.title: Your First Weekend at Nebraska Methodist College of Nursing & Allied Health, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence that starts on the Josie Harper Campus and ends with two Omaha outings.

cards.title: Settle into Josie's Village
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival · campus housing
cards.notes: Use your arrival window to locate your building, unpack essentials, and take a short walk to the Clark Center before planning anything farther away.
cards.short_summary: Start by getting oriented around NMC's on-campus housing.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC identifies Josie's Village as on-campus living in five buildings on the southwest half of the Josie Harper Campus.
cards.access_notes: Campus housing is for eligible NMC residents; confirm move-in and visitor procedures with the College.

cards.title: Find the Clark Center anchors
cards.subtitle: Friday · campus orientation stop
cards.notes: Walk through the Clark Center and note the Student Center, library, fitness resources, bookstore, and dining area so weekday errands feel familiar.
cards.short_summary: Use one building walk-through to identify essential student resources.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC says the Clark Center houses the bookstore, library, computer lab, campus health center, fitness center, student center, labs, and classrooms.
cards.access_notes: On-campus facilities may have student access requirements; consult NMC for building access details.

cards.title: Pause at Deja Brew
cards.subtitle: Friday · Clark Center Lobby
cards.notes: Choose a drink or snack if you want one, then use the lobby stop as a simple reset before returning to your room or meeting a classmate.
cards.short_summary: A named campus food-and-drink stop in the Clark Center Lobby.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC states that Deja Brew is in the Clark Center Lobby and sells breakfast, lunch, dinner, coffee, soft drinks, and snacks.
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks are available for purchase; verify current service before visiting.

cards.title: Make a first library pass
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Clark Center second floor
cards.notes: Locate the John Moritz Library in the LARC, check its student services, and identify a desk or resource you can return to during your first study week.
cards.short_summary: Get acquainted with NMC's primary library before coursework intensifies.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC places the John Moritz Library on the second floor of the Clark Center in the Learning and Academic Resource Commons.
cards.source_title: Campus Life & Facilities | Nebraska Methodist College
cards.access_notes: The library serves NMC students, faculty, staff, NMHS employees, and medical staff; check current access hours before going.

cards.title: Choose a study-room routine
cards.subtitle: Saturday · Clark Center second floor
cards.notes: Walk past the ten quiet study rooms and decide whether you will use one alone or reserve a small-group session after you know your course schedule.
cards.short_summary: Identify a practical place for focused study or a small project group.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC says ten quiet student study rooms are available on the second floor of the Clark Center, with whiteboards and computers.
cards.access_notes: NMC says the rooms may be used individually or in small groups; verify availability or any reservation process locally.

cards.title: Take a wellness-center lap
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Clark Center first floor
cards.notes: Tour the equipment areas, then choose one manageable activity for the coming week, such as a treadmill session or a group-fitness visit.
cards.short_summary: Turn a first look at campus fitness resources into a realistic weekly plan.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC describes the Wellness Engagement Center on the first floor of the Clark Center as having cardio and strength equipment, massage chairs, and a group fitness studio.
cards.source_title: Campus Life & Facilities | Nebraska Methodist College
cards.access_notes: The center is an NMC fitness resource; confirm student eligibility and current operating times with the College.

cards.title: Take a quiet chapel break
cards.subtitle: Saturday · Josie Harper Campus
cards.notes: If reflection or a quiet study pause would help, visit the Chapel briefly and notice its circular space, stained glass, and water wall.
cards.short_summary: A designated campus setting for reflection, prayer, study, or quiet conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC describes its Chapel as a place to think, reflect, pray, study, or spend time with friends, with stained glass and a water wall.
cards.access_notes: Use the space respectfully and check campus access conditions before visiting.

cards.title: Scan ways to get involved
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · NMC student life
cards.notes: Review the organization options, pick one professional or service-oriented area that genuinely fits, and save the contact details for a later meeting.
cards.short_summary: A low-commitment way to identify connections beyond the classroom.
cards.evidence_claim: NMC says student organizations include ambassador programs, honor societies, field-specific professional organizations, leadership, student government, and veterans organizations.
cards.source_title: Student Engagement & Support Services | Nebraska Methodist College
cards.access_notes: Participation details vary by organization; contact NMC Student Engagement for current opportunities.

cards.title: Make a free Sunday museum visit
cards.subtitle: Sunday · 2200 Dodge Street, Omaha
cards.notes: Plan a daytime walk through the permanent galleries, then use one artwork or architectural detail as a shared conversation starter with a new friend.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission-cost Omaha art outing with regular Thursday evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Joslyn states that everyone is admitted at no cost during regular museum hours and that permanent galleries and most temporary exhibitions are included.
cards.source_title: The Joslyn Visit Detail | Joslyn Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Museum hours listed by Joslyn are Tuesday–Sunday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m., with Thursday hours until 8 p.m.; closed Mondays and major holidays.

cards.entity_name: Omaha's Henry Doorly Zoo and Aquarium
cards.title: Save a daytime zoo outing
cards.subtitle: Sunday option · 3701 S 10th Street, Omaha
cards.notes: If you have time and a ticket budget, choose a few named habitats instead of rushing the grounds; check the official page for day-specific hours and closures.
cards.short_summary: A ticketed daytime animal-and-habitat outing for a later first weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: The Zoo's visitor page lists its 3701 S 10th Street address, current seasonal admission rates, and free parking.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Omaha's Henry Doorly Zoo and Aquarium
cards.access_notes: General admission is paid; the official site lists current hours and notes that parking is free. Confirm conditions before travel.
